title: 个人品质与成功素养
desc: 围绕毅力、自律、自信、抗挫、专注、协作、创新与诚信等成功素养的高分表达

entries.zh: 坚持不懈；坚忍不拔（面对困难仍持续努力的品质）
entries.example: It was perseverance rather than sheer talent that enabled him to turn repeated failures into lasting success.
entries.exampleZh: 正是坚持不懈而非纯粹的天赋，使他将一次次失败转化为持久的成功。
entries.note: 不可数名词，常与 show/demonstrate 搭配；主体段分析成功原因时作主语最合适

entries.zh: 坚持不懈地做（某事）；执意于
entries.example: Those who persist in pursuing their goals in the face of setbacks are far more likely to succeed.
entries.exampleZh: 那些面对挫折仍坚持不懈追求目标的人，成功的可能性要大得多。
entries.note: in 是介词，后接名词或动名词，切不可写成 persist to do sth

entries.zh: 坚韧不拔；顽强（尤指绝不轻易松手）
entries.example: The tenacity with which she overcame one obstacle after another won her the respect of her colleagues.
entries.exampleZh: 她克服一个又一个障碍时所表现出的坚韧，赢得了同事们的尊敬。
entries.note: 常用 with tenacity、display tenacity；比 persistence 更有力量感，适合描写人物

entries.example: Only those who persevere through difficulty can taste the genuine sweetness of achievement.
entries.exampleZh: 只有那些在困难中坚持不懈的人，才能品尝到成就带来的真正甘甜。
entries.note: 不及物动词，常接 with sth 或 in doing sth；结尾段呼吁坚持时非常好用

entries.zh: 恪守，坚持（原则、信念、规则等）
entries.example: A person of integrity adheres to his principles even when doing so brings him no immediate benefit.
entries.exampleZh: 正直的人即便恪守原则不会带来即时好处，也依然坚持不移。
entries.note: to 为介词，后接名词或动名词；只用于原则、信念、承诺等抽象对象

entries.zh: 坚定不移的，始终不渝的
entries.example: Her unwavering commitment to the underprivileged has inspired a whole generation of young volunteers.
entries.exampleZh: 她对弱势群体坚定不移的付出激励了整整一代年轻志愿者。
entries.note: 常搭配 unwavering commitment/determination/support；比 firm 更有分量

entries.zh: 不屈不挠的；（努力）持续不断的
entries.example: Through relentless practice, the young athlete gradually narrowed the gap between herself and the champion.
entries.exampleZh: 通过不屈不挠的训练，这位年轻运动员逐渐缩小了自己与冠军之间的差距。
entries.note: 可修饰人或 effort/pursuit；注意其另一义为毫不留情的，描写压力时须看语境

entries.example: Diligence may not guarantee success, but it certainly raises the odds of achieving it.
entries.exampleZh: 勤奋未必保证成功，但它必定会提高成功的概率。
entries.note: 不可数名词；常与 perseverance 并列，用于主体段归纳成才要素

entries.example: Years of painstaking research finally paid off when the team published its groundbreaking findings.
entries.exampleZh: 当团队发表突破性研究成果时，多年的刻苦钻研终于得到了回报。
entries.note: 固定搭配 painstaking efforts/research/work；与 painful 拼写相近但词义完全不同

entries.example: Without self-discipline, even the most gifted students may squander their potential on idle distraction.
entries.exampleZh: 没有自律，即使最有天赋的学生也可能把潜力浪费在无所事事的消遣上。
entries.note: 不可数名词，常与 lack/exercise/develop 连用；分析个人成长原因时极实用

entries.example: Giving up a lifelong habit requires enormous willpower, yet the reward is well worth the struggle.
entries.exampleZh: 戒掉伴随一生的习惯需要巨大的意志力，但回报完全值得这番挣扎。
entries.note: 不可数名词；可替换 determination，多用于克服诱惑与坏习惯的语境

entries.zh: 坚毅，韧劲（已进入正式书面语）
entries.example: Researchers have found that grit predicts long-term achievement better than intelligence does.
entries.exampleZh: 研究者发现，坚毅对长期成就的预测力比智力更强。
entries.note: 不可数名词，常与 show grit 搭配；表勇气时用 true grit，勿与 grid 混淆

entries.example: Building confidence through small victories is far more effective than waiting for a single breakthrough.
entries.exampleZh: 通过一次次小胜利来建立自信，远比等待一次重大突破更为有效。
entries.note: 褒义搭配 build/boost confidence，贬义搭配 dent/undermine confidence

entries.example: Optimism does not mean ignoring difficulties; it means believing that difficulties can be tackled.
entries.exampleZh: 乐观并不意味着忽视困难，而是相信困难可以被克服。
entries.note: 常用 a sense of optimism、cautious optimism；定义式句式适合段落首句破题

entries.zh: 看到事物光明的一面；往好处想
entries.example: Even when plans fell through, she taught her students to look on the bright side of things.
entries.exampleZh: 即使计划落空，她也教学生们凡事往好处想。
entries.note: 固定用单数 bright side，后接 of sth；口语色彩较强，适合例证句或结尾段

entries.example: A pessimistic outlook often discourages people from even attempting what they might accomplish.
entries.exampleZh: 悲观的心态往往使人连尝试本可能完成之事的勇气都没有。
entries.note: 固定搭配 be pessimistic about sth；与 optimistic 成对用于对比论证

entries.example: It is in adversity that true character is revealed and genuine strength is forged.
entries.exampleZh: 正是在逆境中，真正的品格得以显现，真正的力量得以锻造。
entries.note: 不可数名词，搭配 in the face of adversity、overcome adversity；宜放开头或结尾升华

entries.example: Rather than being defeated by this setback, he treated it as a valuable lesson.
entries.exampleZh: 他并未被这次挫折打败，而是把它当作宝贵的一课。
entries.note: 可数名词，常与 suffer/meet with/overcome 连用；复数 setbacks 泛指一连串挫折

entries.example: Growing up in hardship gave him a resilience that no classroom could ever teach.
entries.exampleZh: 在困苦中长大，赋予了他任何课堂都无法教授的抗挫力。
entries.note: 泛指时不可数，指一件件苦难时用 hardships；搭配 endure/experience hardship

entries.example: Financial difficulty is an obstacle, but it is by no means an insurmountable one.
entries.exampleZh: 经济困难是一种障碍，但绝不是无法逾越的障碍。
entries.note: 固定搭配 obstacle to sth，to 为介词；动词搭配 overcome/remove an obstacle

entries.example: Those who surmount formidable barriers often emerge stronger than those who never faced any.
entries.exampleZh: 克服巨大障碍的人，往往比从未遇过障碍的人更为坚强。
entries.note: 及物动词，宾语多为 difficulties/obstacles/barriers；比 overcome 更书面

entries.example: She overcame her fear of public speaking by rehearsing in front of a mirror every evening.
entries.exampleZh: 她每晚对着镜子练习，从而克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
entries.note: 常见搭配 overcome difficulties/fear/prejudice；过去式与过去分词均为 overcame/overcome

entries.zh: 帮助渡过（难关、困难时期）
entries.example: A small loan from a friend tided him over until he found a stable job.
entries.exampleZh: 朋友的一笔小额借款帮他渡过了难关，直到他找到一份稳定的工作。
entries.note: 常用 tide sb over (sth)，宾语置于中间；多指暂时渡过，不用于战胜长期问题

entries.example: Constant notifications on smartphones steadily erode our powers of concentration.
entries.exampleZh: 智能手机上不断的通知正在持续侵蚀我们的专注力。
entries.note: 常用 powers of concentration、lose one's concentration；与 undivided 搭配更地道

entries.example: He devoted himself to scientific research for decades, asking nothing in return but the joy of discovery.
entries.exampleZh: 他数十年致力于科学研究，除发现的乐趣外别无所求。
entries.note: to 为介词，后接名词或动名词；被动式 be devoted to 同样高频

entries.example: When students are fully immersed in a task, learning ceases to feel like a burden.
entries.exampleZh: 当学生完全沉浸于一项任务时，学习便不再像一种负担。
entries.note: 亦可用 immerse oneself in；后接 work/study/a book，描写专注状态比 be busy with 生动

entries.zh: 使人分心的事物；注意力分散
entries.example: Studying in a quiet library removes the distractions that plague work at home.
entries.exampleZh: 在安静的图书馆学习，可以排除那些在家里困扰人的干扰。
entries.note: 指具体诱惑时可数，指分心状态时不可数；常搭配 resist/eliminate distractions

entries.example: Procrastination is not laziness but a habit of trading long-term goals for immediate comfort.
entries.exampleZh: 拖延并非懒惰，而是一种用长远目标换取眼前安逸的习惯。
entries.note: 不可数名词，常作主语；分析效率低下的原因时比 putting things off 更书面

entries.zh: 优先处理，按轻重缓急安排
entries.example: Effective learners prioritize the tasks that matter most instead of reacting to whatever comes first.
entries.exampleZh: 高效的学习者会优先处理最重要的事情，而不是被动应付最先出现的事。
entries.note: 及物动词，宾语为任务或目标；英式拼写 prioritise 亦可，但全文须统一

entries.zh: 合作，协作（强调共同产出成果）
entries.example: Close collaboration between universities and enterprises has accelerated the transfer of new technology.
entries.exampleZh: 高校与企业之间的紧密合作加快了新技术的转化。
entries.note: 常搭配 in collaboration with sb；比 cooperation 更强调共同完成，适合团队类话题

entries.example: Individual brilliance alone cannot replace the synergy that genuine teamwork creates.
entries.exampleZh: 个人的卓越无法取代真正的团队协作所产生的合力。
entries.note: 不可数名词，作主语时谓语用单数；常与 effective/genuine 搭配

entries.example: The two departments achieved a synergy that neither could have produced on its own.
entries.exampleZh: 两个部门实现了任何一方单独都无法产生的协同效应。
entries.note: 常搭配 create/achieve synergy；用来表达一加一大于二时格外地道

entries.example: Mutual support within a team often matters more than any single member's talent.
entries.exampleZh: 团队中的相互支持往往比任何单个成员的才能都更重要。
entries.note: mutual 只用于双方或多方之间；同类搭配有 mutual trust/respect，可与 support 并列

entries.example: A capable leader knows how to coordinate the efforts of people with very different strengths.
entries.exampleZh: 一位有能力的领导者懂得如何协调具有不同特长的人的努力。
entries.note: 及物动词，常搭配 coordinate efforts/activities 或 coordinate with sb；名词为 coordination

entries.example: Creativity thrives in an atmosphere where mistakes are tolerated rather than punished.
entries.exampleZh: 创造力在容许犯错而非惩罚错误的环境中蓬勃发展。
entries.note: 不可数名词；常与 foster/nurture/stifle 搭配，讨论创新环境时用于主体段

entries.example: Sustained innovation, rather than blind imitation, is what keeps a nation competitive.
entries.exampleZh: 使一个国家保持竞争力的，是持续创新而非盲目模仿。
entries.note: 指一项创新时可数，指创新能力时不可数；常搭配 technological innovation

entries.example: Faced with scarce resources, the villagers solved the water shortage with remarkable ingenuity.
entries.exampleZh: 面对稀缺的资源，村民们以非凡的巧思解决了缺水问题。
entries.note: 不可数名词，常搭配 with ingenuity、display ingenuity；侧重巧妙而非高深

entries.zh: 主动性，首创精神；（也可指）倡议
entries.example: Employers value employees who show initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.
entries.exampleZh: 雇主看重的，是那些主动做事而非等着被安排工作的员工。
entries.note: show/display initiative 表主动；on one's own initiative 意为主动地，勿与 initial 混淆

entries.example: Rather than complain about the problem, she took the initiative to organize a volunteer group.
entries.exampleZh: 她没有抱怨问题，而是主动组织起一个志愿者小组。
entries.note: 后常接不定式 to do sth；定冠词 the 不可省略，用于记叙式例证句最自然

entries.zh: 打破常规思考，跳出固有思维
entries.example: To solve such an unusual problem, we must learn to think outside the box.
entries.exampleZh: 要解决这样一个不寻常的问题，我们必须学会跳出固有思维。
entries.note: 固定用 outside，勿改成 out of；口语色彩较浓，适合放在建议句或结尾句

entries.example: Integrity means doing the right thing even when no one is watching.
entries.exampleZh: 正直意味着即使无人监督也做正确的事。
entries.note: 不可数名词，常搭配 personal/professional integrity；定义式短句适合段落开头破题

entries.example: Honesty is the foundation on which all lasting relationships, personal or commercial, are built.
entries.exampleZh: 诚实是所有人际关系——无论私人还是商业——得以持久建立的基础。
entries.note: 不可数名词；常与 integrity 并列使用，作结尾段的价值升华

entries.zh: 问责，责任（须为自己的行为负责）
entries.example: Greater accountability in public office is essential if citizens are to trust their government.
entries.exampleZh: 如果公民要信任政府，公职部门加强问责就十分必要。
entries.note: 不可数名词，搭配 accountability for sth；比 responsibility 更强调可被追究

entries.example: Instead of shifting the blame onto others, he took responsibility for the failure.
entries.exampleZh: 他没有把责任推给别人，而是为这次失败承担了责任。
entries.note: for 后接名词或动名词，勿写成 take responsibility of；shift the blame onto 可作反面搭配

entries.zh: 认真尽责的，勤勉谨慎的
entries.example: A conscientious worker checks every detail twice before submitting a report.
entries.exampleZh: 认真尽责的员工在提交报告前会把每个细节核对两遍。
entries.note: 常修饰 student/worker/attitude；与 conscious 拼写相近，切勿混用

entries.example: Despite his fame, the scientist remained refreshingly down-to-earth in his daily life.
entries.exampleZh: 尽管声名显赫，这位科学家在日常生活中依然务实得令人耳目一新。
entries.note: 复合形容词，连字符不可省；多修饰人物品质，可与 humble 连用于人物描写

entries.example: Her ambition was not to outshine others but to make a difference in rural education.
entries.exampleZh: 她的抱负不是要胜过他人，而是要为乡村教育带来改变。
entries.note: 可数或不可数；实现抱负用 fulfill/realize one's ambition，不可说 reach one's ambition

entries.zh: 志向，渴望（多指向上的追求）
entries.example: Many graduates cherish the aspiration to work in a field that serves the public good.
entries.exampleZh: 许多毕业生怀有在公益领域工作的志向。
entries.note: 常搭配 aspiration to do sth 或 for sth；比 ambition 更偏正面，适合表达理想

entries.zh: 努力，奋斗（为达到目标而不懈努力）
entries.example: Every young person should strive to become a better version of himself.
entries.exampleZh: 每个年轻人都应努力成为更好的自己。
entries.note: 常接 to do sth 或 for sth；strive for excellence 为高频搭配，结尾段很实用

entries.zh: 努力，尽力（动词；亦作名词意为努力）
entries.example: We should endeavor to balance academic pursuit with physical and mental well-being.
entries.exampleZh: 我们应努力在学业追求与身心健康之间取得平衡。
entries.note: 美式拼写 endeavor、英式 endeavour，全文须统一；作名词时用 in an endeavor to do sth

entries.example: The government should spare no effort to narrow the gap between urban and rural schools.
entries.exampleZh: 政府应不遗余力地缩小城乡学校之间的差距。
entries.note: 后接不定式 to do sth；主语常为政府、学校等机构，是结尾段提建议的高分表达

entries.zh: 竭尽全力，不辞辛苦地去做
entries.example: Some parents go to great lengths to secure the best education for their children.
entries.exampleZh: 有些父母竭尽全力为孩子争取最好的教育。
entries.note: 固定搭配 go to great lengths to do sth；great 亦可换 considerable，语气略弱

entries.example: Students should seize the opportunity to broaden their horizons while they are still young.
entries.exampleZh: 学生应趁年轻抓住机会开阔自己的视野。
entries.note: 后接不定式 to do sth；也可用 grasp/take the opportunity，seize 语气最强

entries.zh: 充分利用，最大限度地利用
entries.example: To make the most of university life, one must go far beyond the requirements of the syllabus.
entries.exampleZh: 要充分利用大学生活，就必须远远超越课程大纲的要求。
entries.note: 后接时间、机会、资源等名词；比 make full use of 更自然，适合建议句

entries.example: Nothing gives a learner more of a sense of achievement than mastering a difficult skill.
entries.exampleZh: 对学习者而言，没有什么比掌握一项困难技能更能带来成就感。
entries.note: 固定结构 a sense of achievement/fulfillment/responsibility；作主语或宾语皆可

entries.zh: 满足感，成就感；实现（愿望）
entries.example: Teaching in a remote village brought her a deep sense of fulfillment that no salary could buy.
entries.exampleZh: 在偏远山村教书给她带来了一种薪水买不到的深深的满足感。
entries.note: 英式拼写 fulfilment（单 l），美式 fulfillment；常以 a sense of fulfillment 出现

entries.en: It is ___ that enables us to ___.
entries.zh: 正是___使我们能够___。（强调句式，突出某种品质或因素的决定作用）
entries.example: It is perseverance that enables us to convert repeated failure into ultimate success.
entries.exampleZh: 正是坚持不懈使我们能够将反复的失败转化为最终的成功。
entries.note: 强调句，被强调部分置于 It is 之后；主体段分析原因、结尾段点题均适用

entries.en: Were it not for ___, we would never ___.
entries.zh: 若非___，我们就永远不会___。（虚拟条件倒装，强调某因素不可或缺）
entries.example: Were it not for self-discipline, we would never accomplish anything worth remembering.
entries.exampleZh: 若非自律，我们就永远不会取得任何值得铭记的成就。
entries.note: 省略 if 的虚拟倒装；与现在事实相反用 Were it not for，与过去相反用 Had it not been for

entries.zh: 只有通过___，我们才能___。（only 加状语置于句首引起部分倒装）
entries.example: Only by cooperating with others can we accomplish what no individual could achieve alone.
entries.exampleZh: 只有与他人合作，我们才能完成任何个人都无法独力达成的事。
entries.note: by 后接动名词；主句必须倒装为 can we，结尾段提建议时非常出彩

entries.en: What sets ___ apart from others is ___.
entries.zh: 使___区别于他人之处在于___。（主语从句，用于对比与评价）
entries.example: What sets outstanding achievers apart from others is their refusal to give up when others quit.
entries.exampleZh: 杰出成就者与常人不同之处在于，当别人放弃时他们仍然坚持。
entries.note: what 引导主语从句，谓语一律用单数 is；适合第二段对比论证的开头

entries.en: The more ___ we are, the more likely we are to ___.
entries.zh: 我们越___，就越可能___。（the more…the more 递进比较结构）
entries.example: The more resilient we are, the more likely we are to turn setbacks into stepping stones.
entries.exampleZh: 我们的抗挫力越强，就越有可能把挫折变成垫脚石。
entries.note: 两个分句均以 the 起首并接比较级；用于论证品质与结果之间的正向关系

entries.zh: 没有人能在没有___的情况下___。（双重否定，强调必要条件）
entries.example: No one can attain lasting success without perseverance and a clear sense of purpose.
entries.exampleZh: 没有坚持不懈和清晰的目标感，没有人能获得持久的成功。
entries.note: without 后接名词或动名词；句子简短有力，适合置于段落结论处

entries.en: It is not ___ but ___ that determines whether ___.
entries.zh: 决定___与否的不是___，而是___。（not…but 与强调句合用，用于纠正误解）
entries.example: It is not innate talent but sustained effort that determines whether one can excel.
entries.exampleZh: 决定一个人能否出类拔萃的，不是天赋，而是持续的努力。
entries.note: not A but B 结构中谓语与 B 保持一致；适合驳斥天赋决定论的论证段

entries.en: Where there is a will, there is a way.
entries.example: Where there is a will, there is a way; the only real failure is giving up too soon.
entries.exampleZh: 有志者事竟成；唯一真正的失败是过早放弃。
entries.note: 谚语，可用于开头引入或结尾升华；注意 there 不可写成 their，will 此处意为意志

entries.en: Rome was not built in a day.
entries.zh: 罗马非一日建成（伟业需时）。
entries.example: Rome was not built in a day, so we should not expect instant results from steady effort.
entries.exampleZh: 罗马非一日建成，因此我们不应指望持续的努力能立刻见效。
entries.note: 用于劝人耐心与长期坚持的段落；后可接 so/therefore 引出结论

entries.en: Constant dripping wears away a stone.
entries.example: Constant dripping wears away a stone, which proves that persistence outweighs momentary intensity.
entries.exampleZh: 滴水穿石，这证明坚持胜过一时的猛烈。
entries.note: dripping 为动名词作主语，谓语用 wears；与 perseverance 主题高度呼应

entries.en: Genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
entries.zh: 天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水。（爱迪生）
entries.example: As Edison put it, genius is one percent inspiration and ninety-nine percent perspiration.
entries.exampleZh: 正如爱迪生所说，天才是百分之一的灵感加百分之九十九的汗水。
entries.note: 引用时用 As Edison put it；适合论证勤奋重于天赋的段落

entries.en: Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors.
entries.zh: 平静的海面练不出熟练的水手。
entries.example: Smooth seas do not make skillful sailors, so adversity should be welcomed rather than feared.
entries.exampleZh: 平静的海面练不出熟练的水手，因此逆境应被欢迎而非畏惧。
entries.note: 非洲谚语，比喻逆境造就本领；放在挫折类话题的论点句效果极佳

entries.example: Honesty is the best policy, yet it is precisely in difficult moments that it is hardest to keep.
entries.exampleZh: 诚实为上策，然而恰恰在艰难时刻，它最难坚守。
entries.note: 用于诚信与职业道德话题；后接 yet/however 转折可避免结论平淡

entries.en: United we stand, divided we fall.
entries.example: United we stand, divided we fall, a truth that applies to teams as much as to nations.
entries.exampleZh: 团结则存，分裂则亡，这一道理既适用于国家，也适用于团队。
entries.note: 对仗工整，适合合作与团队精神主题的结尾段，后接同位语补充说明范围
